The '''drone freighter''' was a type of [[Drone barge/Legends|unmanned]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:Drone_freighter_flight_deck.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|flight deck]] of a drone freighter]]
The [[Drone barge/Legends|drone]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] came in a variety of forms, but all models seemingly featured vertical fins in the aft section. Being unmanned, the drone freighter did not require a crew and was instead controlled by a [[command relay]]. Despite this, the freighter had a [[Life support/Legends|breathable]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and was equipped with a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|flight deck]] which could be manned by a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].<ref name="Drone Alone" />

==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of drone freighters was en route to the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] with a cargo of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] components. When [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] learned of this convoy, the Alliance mounted a daring [[Mission to steal hyperdrive components|mission]] to intercept [[Drone vessel 171|one]] of those freighters.<ref name="Drone Alone" />
